data.name: Description
data.value: Say “Hey Jarvis” to call Jarvis. The score shows what Jarvis hears: say it a few times and set the threshold to your voice.

data.name: Peak
data.value: Best score of the last 3 seconds: {0}

data.name: ThresholdHint
data.value: 0.50 by default. Lower it if Jarvis does not hear you; raise it if Jarvis wakes up by itself. Applies at once.

data.name: StatePaused
data.value: Paused while Jarvis listens to you; it starts again right after.

data.name: StateMuted
data.value: The microphone is muted: the wake word hears nothing.

data.name: StateModelsMissing
data.value: The wake word models are missing, so “Hey Jarvis” is not heard. The hotkey and a click on the orb still work. Expected files:

data.name: StateFailed
data.value: The wake word models could not be loaded. The hotkey and a click on the orb still work; the cause is in the log.

data.name: SaveFailed
data.value: The threshold could not be saved: the settings file cannot be written. The cause is in the log.
